title: K&L: Penetrating Backdoor Defense with Key and Locks

contributions.purpose: 系统刻画成功后门攻击的必要条件,并解释现有攻击为何易被防御
contributions.mechanism: 总结后门攻击的三条要求(不破坏语义/能误导输出/无触发时正常),并分析后门算法与模型参数高度绑定(high binding)的性质如何被防御利用
contributions.evaluation: 定性分析,配合 Figure 1 对 fixed/input-dependent 触发器绑定性的可视化说明
contributions.domain: 机器学习安全 / 后门攻击与防御
contributions.source_quote: We summarise three requirements for backdoor attacks, elucidate the high binding nature between backdoor attack algorithms and model parameters. We analyse how backdoor defense leverages high binding property.

contributions.purpose: 设计能穿透几乎所有现有后门防御的攻击算法
contributions.mechanism: Key-Locks (K&L) 算法:把攻击过程解耦为嵌入 locks + 用 key 解锁,可调节解锁等级以对抗不同防御,降低攻击与模型参数的绑定
contributions.evaluation: 在 CIFAR-10 ANP 防御下 ASR 71.59%(显著高于对手且维持高 BA);Tiny ImageNet RNP 防御下 ASR 99.92%/BA 56.53%
contributions.domain: 机器学习安全 / 后门攻击
contributions.source_quote: Our Key-Locks (K&L) algorithm decouples the attack algorithm from model parameters, successfully penetrating nearly all existing backdoor defense mechanisms.

contributions.purpose: 提供评估后门攻击穿透防御能力的新度量
contributions.mechanism: 提出 Accuracy-ASR Curve (AAC) 指标,x 轴为判定防御成功的 ASR 阈值、y 轴为穿透率,并计算曲线下面积 AAV
contributions.evaluation: 扩展实验用 AAC/AAV 验证 K&L 相对基线对几乎所有当前防御策略的有效性(如 AAC3 允许 3% 精度损失场景)
contributions.domain: 机器学习安全 / 评估指标
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a new metric: the Accuracy-ASR Curve (AAC). Extensive experiments validate the performance of the K&L algorithm, demonstrating its effectiveness against nearly all current backdoor defense strategies.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Subfigure (a) delineates the process of fixed trigger integration (blue points) in techniques like BadNet (Gu et al., 2017). This method essentially constructs an additional decision boundary that must be wholly encoded within the model's parameters.
(b) visualizes defense strategies (green points) such as ANP (Wu & Wang, 2021) that manipulate the decision boundary to form a 'defense gap'

notes: 负结果/trade-off:消融中报告 epoch 从 2 增到 12 时 ASR 略降(『trade-off between extended training and attack effectiveness』);attack step size 增益在 step size > 1 后进入平台。局限自陈:K&L 需保存 key,增加与模型规模相关的计算资源开销,但作者认为攻击有效性值得该成本。
